message.content:
A vertical rectangular editorial illustration features a light teal background with a red vertical stripe on the left edge. The central figure is a profile illustration of a woman with light skin and short, dark, curly hair. Her hair transitions upward into a large, dark, tangled net structure that curls into an "S" shape. Small dark circles and light spots are scattered within the net and the background. She wears a collared, light-green shirt and looks toward the left.

The top of the illustration contains the word "TEMPO" in large, light-gray letters. Above it are the phrases "OPERASI MILITER MENGGASAK PEROMPAK" and "INVESTIGASI: PENCOLENG MINYAK PERTAMINA". A small logo with "45" and "1971-2016" is on the left. The date "4-10 APRIL 2016" appears below the logo. On the left side, large bold black text reads "MERINGKUS SUSI". Below this, smaller white text says: "Memerangi pencurian ikan, Menteri Kelautan dan Perikanan berkonflik dengan Wakil Presiden Jusuf Kalla." The bottom right corner displays a barcode and "RP 39.500".
